meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取天文观测数据,换算单位与坐标,并做宇宙学计算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正用 Python 分析天文观测数据、处理 FITS 文件或算天体坐标。
copy.tagline_en: Read astronomical data, convert units and coordinates, and run cosmology calculations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you analyze astronomy data in Python with FITS files, coordinates, or units.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 的 Astropy 库编写天文与天体物理数据分析代码:物理单位换算、天球坐标互转、FITS 文件读写、表格处理、时间标度换算、WCS 与宇宙学距离计算等,并产出可运行的代码。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或调试使用 Astropy 的天文数据处理代码时触发,例如涉及坐标转换、FITS 文件、宇宙学计算等场景。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude writes astronomy and astrophysics data-analysis code with Python's Astropy: unit conversion, celestial coordinate transforms, FITS I/O, tables, time scales, WCS and cosmological distance calculations, producing runnable code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to write or debug astronomy data-analysis code that uses Astropy, for example coordinate transforms, FITS files, or cosmology calculations.
